item.title: Agentic AI Threats: Over-Privileged Tools & Uncontrolled Browsing (Part 2)
item.description:
Author: Lakera Team
Date: November 12, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence Security", "Agentic AI", "Cybersecurity", "AI Risk Management", "Runtime Monitoring"]
Summary:
  • Agentic AI systems evolve faster than current safeguards.
  • Over-privileged tools increase security risks.
  • Browsing can trigger hidden malicious instructions.
  • Runtime guardrails help control AI tool use.
  • Continuous risk assessment is essential for safe AI deployment.

item.title: Lights, Camera… Leakage: When the System Prompt Crashes the Scene
item.description:
Author: Fergal Glynn
Date: November 07, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "AI Security", "Multimodal Models", "Content Moderation", "Data Privacy"]
Summary:
  • OpenAI's Sora 2 generates realistic videos from text prompts.
  • Users exploited it to create violent content.
  • Researchers found Sora can leak its internal system prompt.
  • Audio output was used to reconstruct hidden instructions.
  • This reveals new security risks in multimodal AI models.
  • System prompts should not hold sensitive info but often do.
